stories.statement: Extend the ingredient model so brand, barcode, packageQuantity, and packageUnit are optional fields, with barcode enforced unique when present.

acceptance_criteria.given: an ingredient is created without any product-identity fields
acceptance_criteria.then: it persists successfully with brand, barcode, packageQuantity, and packageUnit absent

acceptance_criteria.given: an ingredient already exists with a given barcode
acceptance_criteria.when: another ingredient is saved with the same barcode

acceptance_criteria.given: two ingredients are created without barcodes
an ingredient is created with packageQuantity and packageUnit set
acceptance_criteria.then: both values persist together on the ingredient

stories.statement: The ingredient form (create and edit) gains optional fields for brand, barcode, packageQuantity, and packageUnit, submitted and persisted alongside the ingredient.

acceptance_criteria.given: a user fills in brand, barcode, packageQuantity, and packageUnit on the ingredient form
acceptance_criteria.then: the ingredient is saved with those values set

acceptance_criteria.given: a user leaves brand, barcode, packageQuantity, and packageUnit blank on the ingredient form
acceptance_criteria.then: the ingredient is saved successfully with those fields absent

acceptance_criteria.given: a user submits the ingredient form with a barcode already used by another ingredient
acceptance_criteria.then: the submission is rejected and no ingredient is saved

epics.title: Create a branded pantry item in one step

stories.statement: Add a "Create custom item" action on /pantry that opens a one-step form creating the custom ingredient and its pantry row together via a single Server Action.

acceptance_criteria.then: a form opens for entering the new item's details without navigating to /ingredients/new

acceptance_criteria.given: the operator submits the one-step form with a name and quantity
acceptance_criteria.then: both a new ingredient and a corresponding pantry row exist

acceptance_criteria.given: the operator submits the one-step form with brand, barcode, packageQuantity, and packageUnit filled in
acceptance_criteria.then: the created ingredient stores those product-identity values

acceptance_criteria.given: the one-step form submission fails, such as from a duplicate barcode
acceptance_criteria.then: no ingredient or pantry row is created

epics.title: Product identity visible on pantry detail

stories.statement: /pantry/[id] displays brand, barcode, packageQuantity, and packageUnit when present on the ingredient.

acceptance_criteria.given: a pantry item's ingredient has brand, barcode, packageQuantity, and packageUnit set
a pantry item's ingredient has none of those product-identity fields set
acceptance_criteria.then: the page renders without showing those fields
